Sophia: Heads-up — platform + runtime sync. We need a single canonical panel for canary regressions that shows latency tails and per-route token-cost drift. Any initial thoughts on telemetry inputs?
Kevin: Agree. Today’s spike looked route-specific. We need per-route token attribution + request-level cost where possible.
Anika: Can runtime emit a prefix_id so dashboard can correlate cache hit ratio? That'd help separate cache vs model regressions.
Ops-Joe: From infra side: we can emit sample-weighted counters and p50/p95/p99 latencies per route + per-model-variant. Pushing per-request token_count for all requests is high-cardinality though.
Sophia: Question: do we want raw per-request token_count, or histogram buckets? Histograms are cheaper to store/aggregate.
Matthew: Recommend histograms + a small fraction of raw samples (1% sampling) for regression-signature diffs. Also add tags model_variant and quant_label. Example metric names:
```
metrics:
  - name: runtime.latency.hist
    tags: [route, model_variant, quant_label]
  - name: runtime.tokens.hist
    tags: [route, model_variant]
```
Kevin: UX/alerting note: Dashboard should compute Control vs Variant delta with CI bands and show effect size, not just absolute p95 delta. Also let users bind a synthetic prompt set overlay.
Anika: Agree. We need synthetic overlay and a way to lock the same prompt set across comparisons for reproduction.
Kevin: How do we normalize cost drift? Suggest derived unit_cost = tokens * model_cost_per_token (model_cost mapping maintained by platform). Dashboard calculates cost_delta from that.
Deploy-bot: deploy started: rollout/ab/2026-03-20-09:04 by @lisa
Lisa: FYI we already tag requests with route_id, model_hash, and plan_tier. I can add quant_label in the next deploy.
Ops-Joe: Concrete metric emits we can do: request.count_by(route,variant), tokens.sum_by(route,variant) (hist), latency.hist_by(route,variant). Then dashboard derives token-per-request and cost-per-request.
Kevin: Retention asks: histograms 7d raw, aggregated 90d. Raw samples TTL 14d. Thoughts?
Anika: For rollouts we need 30d aggregated at minimum to detect slow regressions that accumulate.
Matthew: Also propose emitting a regression_signal annotation event when effect_size > threshold and pval < 0.01 over a sliding 24h window. Dashboards can surface these as timeline annotations.
Sophia: Action items: 1) infra emits latency.hist and tokens.hist with tags [route, model_variant, quant_label]; 2) SDK/runtime adds 1% raw token_count sampling; 3) product builds comparison panel with CI + effect size and synthetic prompt overlay; 4) ops adds regression_event alert. Owners?
Kevin: I'll own dashboard spec + panel mapping.
Lisa: I'll own runtime telemetry changes and will PR next week.
Anika: I'll draft the UX overlay for synthetic prompts and share wireframes.
Sophia: :thumbsup: reconvene Tues 11am after PRs. If infra needs metric wireformat details, ping me in-thread.
